notify.scheduleRestored.body.other: Something had removed {{.what}}, most likely an upgrade. It is running again.

notify.what.both.other: the schedule and the bulk-deletion watcher

status.conflict.title.other: Another agent is also taking snapshots

status.fdaWarning.other: Granting Full Disk Access to this application may not be enough on its own: the scheduled task runs as a separate program and needs it too.

status.headline.nothingTakingMore.one: {{.Count}} snapshot, but nothing is taking more
status.headline.nothingTakingMore.other: {{.Count}} snapshots, but nothing is taking more

status.lowSpace.title.other: Free space is low, so retention is not guaranteed

status.noSchedule.detail.other: macOS only schedules local snapshots when Time Machine has a backup destination. Without one, and without this schedule, today's snapshot is the last one.

status.noSnapshots.detail.other: Nothing can be rolled back to. Taking one now costs no disk space immediately, because a snapshot only grows as the files it recorded change.

status.noSnapshotsShort.other: No snapshots — nothing to roll back to

status.noTripwire.detail.other: A schedule limits how far back you can go; it does not stop a deletion finishing. The watcher takes a snapshot as soon as something starts removing files in bulk, so the rest of that deletion stays recoverable.

status.noTripwire.title.other: Nothing is watching for bulk deletion

status.overdue.detail.other: A snapshot was due at {{.due}} and the newest is still from {{.newest}}. Check the scheduled task's log.

status.scheduleMissingBinary.title.other: The schedule points at a copy of Snapshotter that is gone

status.scheduleNotRunning.detail.other: launchd has the job on disk but has not loaded it, so no snapshot will be taken.

status.scheduleNotRunning.title.other: The schedule is installed but not running

status.simulatedMounts.detail.other: SNAPSHOTTER_FAKE_MOUNTS is set. Everything inside a snapshot is invented for development, and Replace restores are refused. Nothing shown under a snapshot is real.

status.timeMachineThins.title.other: Time Machine will thin these snapshots

status.tripwireNotRunning.detail.other: It is installed but launchd has not loaded it, so nothing is watching.

status.tripwireNotRunning.title.other: The bulk-deletion watcher is not running

tray.coverageCaption.other: Last two days (mark represents an hour)
